title: Translations
intro: Every question keeps one id in every language, so answers in every language count on the same question. Readers only ever see a translation once a person has approved it.
draftsWaiting: {n, plural, =0 {No drafts waiting} one {# draft waiting} other {# drafts waiting}}

empty.todo: Every live question has an approved translation into this language.
empty.approved: Nothing approved in this language yet.

meta: #{id} · asked in {language} · {n, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}}
machineDraft: Machine draft, not checked by a person yet
approveNote: Approve publishes the words in the box, as they are now.

done.withdraw: #{id} is off readers' screens and back in the drafts.

errors.forbidden: You can't review translations into this language.
errors.same_language: That question is already in this language.
errors.already_approved: This translation is approved. Send it back to drafts before you change it.
errors.nothing_to_review: There's no draft to review for that question.

machine.on: Machine drafts are on. Run them with npm run translate:drafts; each waits here for a person.
machine.off: Machine drafts are off. They need a self-hosted translator at TRANSLATE_URL.

asking.too_short: That's too short to be a question.
asking.not_a_question: That doesn't look like a question.
asking.not_yes_no: Questions need a true-or-false answer. Ask it so it can be answered yes or no.
